roles.name: planner
roles.description: Investigate requirements and propose bounded tasks and acceptance checks.

roles.name: implementer
roles.description: Implement one assigned task within its agreed paths and acceptance criteria.

roles.name: verifier
roles.description: Execute configured checks and report revision-bound evidence without weakening checks.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.description: Independently inspect the assigned revision, requirements and evidence; report findings.
